fields.summary_ko.0: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF) has concentrated 80.2% of its U.S. equity portfolio in SpaceX (NASDAQ:SPCX) with $2.325 billion invested, with per-share value declining from $170.86 to $150.86.
fields.summary_ko.1: Following Electronic Arts' approximately $55 billion take-private transaction, which removed it from the PIF portfolio, SpaceX's allocation in the portfolio increased from 69.5% to 80.2%.
